title: Alien in Cosmic Kitchen
description: A grey alien with large black eyes and antennae stands in a retro kitchen, reaching into an open yellow refrigerator filled with purple glowing food and planets. The scene includes green cabinets, a black sink with an open book and mug, and a stained glass window depicting a desert landscape with floating heads and a UFO.
prompt: A detailed illustration of a grey alien with big black eyes and antennae standing in a retro kitchen, opening a bright yellow refrigerator that glows purple inside with cosmic food and floating planets. Green cabinets above, black sink with open book, mug, and lavender on the counter. A colorful stained glass window shows a desert scene with a UFO, floating heads, and swirling purple sky. Whimsical and surreal style with patterned wallpaper.
